value.rationale: An exact time-resolved extinction basin is a natural initialization statistic not implied by periodic-orbit counts, and the complete infinite-family formula distinguishes sharply between hub-dominant and balanced graph-shape limits. The sharp upper-support boundary at four iterations is a meaningful dynamical classification; no artificial parameter slicing is required.
